steps.body: Three groups can join into one total. Add two of them first, then join the third — the answer is the same however you start.
steps.narration: Three groups can join into one total. Add two of them first, then join the third — the answer is the same however you start.

widget.prompt: Add 4 + 3 first, then join 2. Start at 7 and count on 2.
widget.missFeedback: Start at 7 and count on 2: you land on 9.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 9 — 4 + 3 made 7, and joining 2 more reaches the total 9.

predict.prompt: Three groups join together. Is the total bigger or smaller than any one group?
predict.reveal: Joining groups only adds, so the total is at least as big as every group in it.
